===Alternative forms===

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*men- (think)}}
From {{inh|en|enm|musical}}, from {{der|en|fro|}}, from {{der|en|la-med|mūsicālis}}, from {{der|en|la|mūsica|t=music}} {{suffix|la||ālis|pos2=suffix forming adjectives|nocat=1}}; equivalent to {{suffix|en|music|al}}.

* {{audio|en|en-us-musical.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyph|en|mu|si|cal}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# Of, belonging or relating to [[music]], or to its performance or notation.
#: {{co|en|'''musical''' proportion}}
#: {{co|en|'''musical''' instruments}}
# Pleasing to the ear; sounding agreeably; having the qualities of music; melodious; harmonious.
#: {{ux|en|She had a '''musical''' voice.}}
# [[fond|Fond]] of music; [[discriminating]] with regard to music; [[gifted]] or skilled in music.
#: {{co|en|having a '''musical''' ear}}
#: {{ux|en|The child is '''musical'''.}}
# Pertaining to a class of games in which players move while music plays, but have to take a fixed position when it stops; by extension, any situation where people repeatedly change positions.

Chuck wants a football, Kathleen a tattoo.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-07|author=w:Joseph Stiglitz|volume=188|issue=26|page=19|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly|title=Globalisation is about taxes too|url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2013/may/27/globalisation-is-about-taxes-too|passage=It is time the international community faced the reality: we have an unmanageable, unfair, distortionary global tax regime. {{...}} It is the starving of the public sector which has been pivotal in America no longer being the land of opportunity – with a '''child''''s life prospects more dependent on the income and education of its parents than in other advanced countries.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261013204907/https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2013/may/27/globalisation-is-about-taxes-too|archivedate=13 October 2026}} #* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Dakin Andone|title=3 children who are US citizens — including one with cancer — deported with their mothers, lawyers and advocacy groups say|url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/04/27/us/children-us-citizens-deported-honduras/index.html|date=2025-04-27|passage=In one case, a mother was deported and took her 2-year-old '''child''' with her, while the other involves another mother deported and her 4- and 7-year-old '''children''' went with her, the American Civil Liberties Union and the National Immigration Project, among other organizations, said in a news release Friday.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260830094739/https://www.cnn.com/2025/04/27/us/children-us-citizens-deported-honduras/index.html|archivedate=30 August 2026}} ## # The effect upon the [[judgment]] or [[feeling]]s produced by any [[event]], whether [[witness]]ed or [[participate]]d in; [[personal]] and [[direct]] impressions as contrasted with [[description]] or fancies; personal [[acquaintance]]; actual [[enjoyment]] or [[suffering]].

# {{lb|en|countable}} An [[activity]] one has [[perform]]ed.
# {{lb|en|usually|uncountable}} A [[collection]] of [[event]]s and/or [[activity|activities]] from which an individual or group may gather [[knowledge]], [[opinion]]s, and [[skill]]s.
#: {{ux|en|Virtually all employers now require jobseekers to have work '''experience''' even for entry-level roles. Many believe this will hurt companies in the long run.}}

#* {{RQ:Locke Human Understanding|2|1|text=Whence has it all the materials of reason and knowledge? To this I answer in one word, from '''experience'''.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2024|author=NTSB| title=Intersection Crash Between Passenger Car and Combination Vehicle, Tishomingo, Oklahoma, March 22, 2022
   | passage= We determined that the car driver’s transportation of multiple teen passengers, limited driving '''experience''', and likely impairment from effects of cannabis at the time of the crash adversely affected her judgment of the danger of entering the intersection in front of the approaching combination vehicle.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The knowledge thus gathered.
# {{lb|en|corporate}} A [[business]] [[offering]] in which a [[major]] [[focus]] is the way that the [[customer]] [[interact]]s with the [[business]] throughout the [[transaction]], as opposed to only its [[outcome]] (the [[product]] or [[service]]).
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1999|title=Journal of Integrated Communications
|text=CDNOW's custom music selection and Levi Strauss & Co.'s custom-fit jean service are also good examples of giving customers more than just the product, but an '''experience''' as well.}}

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|enm|awaiten}}, from {{der|en|fro-nor|awaitier||to lie in wait for, watch, observe}}, originally especially with a hostile sense; itself from {{m|fro|a-||to}} + {{m|fro|waitier||to watch}}.<ref>{{R:Online Etymology Dictionary}}</ref> More at {{cog|en|wait}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈweɪt/|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-await.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪt|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|formal}} To [[wait for]].
#: {{ux|en|I '''await''' your reply to my letter.}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=2|passage=I had occasion […] to make a somewhat long business trip to Chicago, and on my return […] I found Farrar '''awaiting''' me in the railway station. He smiled his wonted fraction by way of greeting, […], and finally leading me to his buggy, turned and drove out of town.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[expect]].
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To be [[in store]] for; to be [[ready]] or [[in waiting]] for.
#: {{ux|en|Glorious rewards '''await''' the good in heaven; eternal suffering '''awaits''' mortal sinners in hell.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|intransitive}} To [[serve]] or [[attend]]; to [[wait on]], [[wait upon]].
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[watch]], [[observe]].
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To wait; to stay in waiting.
#: {{ux|en|These are exotic lands where great adventures '''await'''.}}

====Usage notes====
* As '''await''' means ''to wait for'', it is not followed by "for". ''*I am awaiting for your reply'' is therefore incorrect.

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|wait for}} {{l|en|wait for}}, {{l|en|anticipate}}, {{l|en|listen}} (of a sound); See also [[Thesaurus:wait for]]
* {{sense|serve or attend}} {{l|en|attend to}}, {{l|en|service}}; See also [[Thesaurus:serve]]
